effect.isekai_mahou.soaked.description: Wet: Lightning causes ELECTROCUTE (×2 damage, stuns and arcs to other Wet targets); Ice FREEZES instantly; Ice stacks twice as fast; Fire deals −50% and only evaporates the water. Puts out Burning. Water and rain make you wet.
effect.isekai_mahou.burning.description: Burning (1–5): magic damage every second, +8% Fire damage taken and −30% healing per stack. Water and rain put it out.
effect.isekai_mahou.chilled.description: Chilled (1–5): −12% speed, −8% attack speed, +15% casting time and −20% mana regeneration per stack. At 5 stacks becomes Frozen.
effect.isekai_mahou.frozen.description: Frozen: trapped in ice — cannot move, attack or cast. Physical and Earth hits SHATTER the ice (×1.75 damage). 6 s of immunity after thawing.
effect.isekai_mahou.shocked.description: Shocked (1–3): Lightning damage +15% per stack, chance of tiny stuns and mana loss. Wet and Shocked targets spark to nearby Wet targets.
effect.isekai_mahou.bleeding.description: Bleeding (1–10): damage every second per stack, doubled while moving. Wind LACERATES (+3 stacks).
effect.isekai_mahou.petrified.descriptio: Petrification (1–3): Stiffening slows by 20% per stack; at 3 becomes Petrified — stone for 2 s, unable to move, +50% armor. Earth and physical hits SHATTER.
effect.isekai_mahou.corrupted.descriptio: Corrupted: continuous shadow damage, faster at higher levels.
effect.isekai_mahou.exposed.description: Exposed: takes +25% magic damage per level.
effect.isekai_mahou.stunned.description: Stunned: cannot walk or jump and barely attacks.
effect.isekai_mahou.rooted.description: Rooted: stuck to the ground, but can still attack.
message.isekai_mahou.status.frozen_no_ca: You are frozen and cannot cast!
message.isekai_mahou.status.petrified_no: You turned to stone and cannot cast!
gamerule.mahouSpellDestruction.descripti: Powerful spells blast craters, cut and burn the terrain. Cities and the Trials dimension stay protected.
command.isekai_mahou.destruction.status: Spell terrain destruction — rule mahouSpellDestruction: %s · config spellBlockDestruction: %s · mobGriefing (mobs): %s · blocks queued: %s
command.isekai_mahou.destruction.on: Terrain destruction ON: strong spells will blast real craters (cities stay protected).
command.isekai_mahou.destruction.off: Terrain destruction OFF: spells no longer change blocks.
command.isekai_mahou.destruction.no_rule: The destruction game rule is not registered yet (the mod has not finished loading).
command.isekai_mahou.destruction.denied: Nothing was destroyed (destruction off, protected area or no permission).
